text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of the tryouts finally arrives.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Lotus roots, celery stalks,
spinach leaves...
Lotus roots, celery stalks,
spinach leaves...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It's for good luck!
This chant will allow me
to focus my willpower and
perform to the
best of my ability!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I've trained as much as I could! Regardless of how this race turns out, I will make you my trainer!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Howdy, Fukukitaru! How ya feelin'?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um... We'd like to watch you run today, if
you don't mind.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Taiki, Suzuka! Are you here to cheer
for me?! It's nice knowing
the two of
you've got my back!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It's been a busy couple of weeks, but I
think I'm ready, thanks to you
guys!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Don't even mention it! Tear up that
racetrack! Show 'em what you've got!
Don't worry about Suzuka and me. We'll
be making our debut
soon enough too!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for the head start, you two! See you
at the Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
All right,
then... It's about time I head out.
I'll try not to lose too hard!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, give it your—
Wait, what?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Thanks! Be back soon!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um... Does she intend on losing or
something?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The race soon commences, and
Matikanefukukitaru blasts out of the

starting gate.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
This much-awaited race is completely
packed with extremely skilled
runners!
Who will come out on top?!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Matikanefukukitaru is falling behind! Are
the leading Umamusume too
fast for her?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Mgrrrgh! They're all... so fast...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
That's fine though.
I just need to do what I
promised I would—run!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Let's goooo! Super Fortune Daaaaash!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The runners have made their final turn and
are entering the final
stretch!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Matikanefukukitaru is picking up the pace
from behind! Will she be
able to close the
gap?!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Yeeeaaah!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Maaan, I thought for a second there that I
could overtake them all...
How'd I still end
up in last place?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Still,
you were so close... Had you another
fifty meters, you would've
easily cleared
the whole group.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I know, right?! You might've been last,
but
you definitely had the
biggest impact!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Awww, you guys are being too nice.

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Matikanefukukitaru! There you are!
Please, let me scout you!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Huh? You want to... scout me?

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
That burst of speed during the last leg of
the race was a sight to
behold! I'm positive
that you and I can accomplish anything
together!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer B
text_block_list.text: No, she needs my guidance! I'll be the one to scout her!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! Why are all these people coming
to me? I was in last place!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, but destiny has already decided my
trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Matikanefukukitaru politely declines the
offers from the trainers
around her and
looks my way.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her belief in divinations is unrivaled,
and it goes without saying she's
a real character.
Yet I can tell she loves running more than
anything.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ummm... I'm not very good under pressure.
Whenever I get nervous, I
feel like I'll start
babbling some random incantation at any
moment...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Now that's more like it! Good
fortune doesn't just come to
those who
wait around doing nothing! Let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With tryouts behind us,
I officially take on
the role of
Matikanefukukitaru's trainer.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
So how about we get started? Not a
second to waste!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hm, actually... Before we begin, could I
ask you one small favor?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I was doing a carrot divination earlier,
and it said that partner running would be
today's lucky activity. Problem is,
Suzuka's
busy today...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Could you run with me today?! Please, just
this once!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
No worries! If you start falling behind,
I'll
just drag you along! So let's
goooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before I can even begin to question my
decisions thus far, she takes off running,
leaving me with no choice but to
frantically attempt to
keep up.
